newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE SHARES SEEN BULLISH FOR SOME WEEKS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE SHARES SEEN BULLISH FOR SOME WEEKS.

text.p: index broke into record territory on Tuesday during strong
performance by several heavyweight counters, which some brokers
see running for at least two weeks.
"The market is very bullish. There are a lot of foreign
investors and also a lot of local money floating around," one
"Interest in the heavyweights is considerable and I think we
will see (the industrial) index continuing to break into record
highs for some time," he added.
The 58-counter industrial pointer jumped 106.74 to a new all
time record of 10,798.63, boosted by strong trade in a number of
stocks, including newly-listed National Merchant Bank
which rose 100 cents to 3,500 and sugar producer Hippo
The ZSE's secondary seven-share mining index closed on
